title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: when an account qualifies for Premier Money Market or Money Market Account on an upgrade request
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks to move the account up to the highest-ranked money market tier they qualify for. It states the balance test for Premier Money Market and for Money Market Account.

## Policy clause

1. **Premier Money Market** qualifies when the balance compared is at least its minimum opening deposit, USD 10000.00.
2. **Money Market Account** qualifies when the balance compared is at least its minimum opening deposit, USD 2500.00.

Neither test adds a checking account condition.

## Quick reference

| Tier | Qualifies when the balance compared is at least |
|---|---|
| Premier Money Market | USD 10000.00 |
| Money Market Account | USD 2500.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical balances)

| Balance compared | Premier Money Market | Money Market Account |
|---|---|---|
| USD 10000.00 | qualifies (equal is enough) | qualifies |
| USD 9999.99 | does not qualify | qualifies |
| USD 2500.00 | does not qualify | qualifies (equal is enough) |
| USD 2499.99 | does not qualify | does not qualify |

## Points of judgement

**Does Premier Money Market require a Premier Checking account in this test?** No; its test here is the balance alone.

**A balance of USD 12000.00 qualifies for both tiers. Does that settle the target?** Each tier's test only says whether that tier qualifies; the target is the highest-ranked tier the account qualifies for.
